title.instructions: hypermnesic engine. Short title. LS Linear keys (LS-…) only if already known. Never invent issue IDs. No secrets, no operator hostnames.

branchName.instructions: Branch off origin/dev, never main. main is release-only. ASCII slug feat/ls-123-short-desc or fix/ls-123-short-desc. Use a worktree; do not switch the canonical clone.

commitMessage.instructions: Conventional commit with a Signed-off-by DCO line. No OpenAI keys, OAuth secrets, operator hosts, or real Tailscale names. Use placeholders in docs/fixtures.

pullRequest.instructions: Target dev, never main. Do not pass --base main. Link LS- only if known. Docs that the change touches must land in the same PR. Do not start the live MCP/OAuth stack from a worktree.
